purpose: A machine-readable contract for AI agents integrating with PFP.

entrypoints.usage_example: from pathlib import Path; from pfp_runtime import PFPFactory; worker = PFPFactory().build_worker(infra_path=Path('examples/01_minimal_quickstart/infra.yaml')); report = worker.run(Path('examples/01_minimal_quickstart/input/input.jsonl').read_bytes())

required.name: infra_path
required.description: Absolute or relative path to the main infra.yaml configuration file.

required.name: input_data
required.description: Raw input bytes passed to PFPWorker.run(...).

diff_semantics.description: Avoid incremental regex-based edits on YAMLs. Generate complete valid YAML representations. Obey determinism rules (generated_at).

commands.smoke_install: pip install -e . && python -c "from pfp_runtime import PFPFactory"
commands.fast_tests: pytest tests/ -m "not matrix and not e2e and not perf and not chaos"
